facts.text: Retailers must conspicuously post their refund policy on the item, at the cash register, store entrance, or online near the item or before billing information is requested.
facts.quote: Every retail mercantile establishment and online retailer shall conspicuously post, in the following manner, its refund policy as to all goods, wares or merchandise offered to the public for sale: (a) on a sign attached to the item itself; or (b) on a sign affixed to each cash register or point of sale; or (c) on a sign so situated as to be clearly visible to the buyer from the cash register; or (d) on a sign posted at each store entrance used by the public; or (e) in case of an online retailer, by a notice displayed or made accessible by hyperlink near the item itself or by a notice displayed to or made accessible by hyperlink by the consumer prior to requesting billing information.

facts.text: Consumers must be advised they can request a written copy of the store's refund policy.
facts.quote: (b) advise consumers that they are entitled to a written copy of the store's refund policy upon request.

facts.text: If a retailer violates the refund policy posting requirements, the buyer can get a cash refund or credit within 30 days of purchase if the merchandise is unused and purchase can be verified.
facts.quote: Any retail mercantile establishment or online retailer which violates any provision of this section shall be liable, for a period of up to thirty days from the date of purchase, to the buyer for a cash refund or a credit, at the buyer's option, provided that the merchandise has not been used or damaged by the buyer and the buyer can verify the date of the purchase with a receipt or any other purchase verification method utilized by the retail merchant.
